aiCodeContextCollector.storageDirectory.description: Custom directory path (relative to workspace root or absolute) to store generated Markdown files. Leave empty to use workspace root + .ai-context/.

aiCodeContextCollector.ollama.enabled.description: Enable optional local Ollama LLM assistance for candidate relevance ranking.

aiCodeContextCollector.ollama.endpoint.description: Local Ollama server API endpoint (default: http://localhost:11434).

aiCodeContextCollector.ollama.model.description: Local Ollama model name (e.g., qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, llama3.2:1b).

aiCodeContextCollector.ollama.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Ollama requests before falling back to static analysis.

aiCodeContextCollector.maxRelationshipDe.description: Maximum depth for traversing code relationships (Route -> Controller -> Service -> Model).

aiCodeContextCollector.maxCandidateFiles.description: Maximum number of candidate files to evaluate with Ollama or rank in candidate selection.

aiCodeContextCollector.maxFiles.description: Maximum total files to include in generated Markdown context.

aiCodeContextCollector.maxContextSizeKB.description: Maximum context file size in KB before trimming lower-confidence candidates.

aiCodeContextCollector.maxFileSizeKB.description: Skip scanning individual source files larger than this threshold.

aiCodeContextCollector.includeProjectStr.description: Include filtered project directory tree in the generated context Markdown.

aiCodeContextCollector.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns and directory names to exclude from analysis and context collection.
